name: ACHETER-LOUER.FR
summary: Acheter-Louer.Fr SA provides communications solutions for commercial development and the valorization of the trades of client's independent real estate agents. It offers Buy-louer.fr, Actua Immo, and Paris Real Estate newspapers to individuals in mailboxes and displays. The company also operates Buy-Louer.fr, a real estate advertising site in France, as well as develops personalized Websites. In addition, it offers newspaper editions signs, realization tools of sales aids, and advisory services on communication strategy. The company is headquartered in Les Ulis, France. Acheter-Louer.Fr SA is a subsidiary of Adomos S.A.
